items.label: 17 MONTH WEEKLY CALENDAR
items.value: This POPRUN August 2026 - December 2027 academic calendar planner combines weekly and monthly layouts with hourly scheduling, crafted for student and professional. Perfect for class schedules, assignment tracking, meetings, and personal goals—all in one hardcover school year planner.

items.label: WORK WITH WEEKLY AND MONTHLY LAYOUT
items.value: Weekly horizontal layout includes ample space to write. A week is laid to view on 2 pages, allowing for the recording of daily notes. Each monthly layout contains an overview of the month. Extra pages include yearly overviews, holidays pages, contacts, and dotted notes.

items.label: SMALL FORMAT AND PREMIUM PAPER QUALITY
items.value: This 3.5″ x 6.5″ pocket format planner calendar is compact and lightweight, and perfect for on the go planning in your bag or purse. 100 GSM invory colour paper ensures an ultra-smooth writing experience for your notes and schedules, while the sturdy hardcover safeguards your planner from wear and tear.

items.label: BUILT-IN EXTRAS
items.value: Tear-Off Corners and Bookmark Ribbons are added to mark any wanted page of your choice. A rear pocket for notes, stickers, or receipts. The lay-flat binding ensure smooth writing.

items.label: ECO-CONSCIOUS & THOUGHTFULLY CRAFTED
items.value: POPRUN Time Works Wonders planners are made with responsibly sourced materials and eco-friendly production processes. We combine functionality with sustainability—so you can organize your life while supporting a greener planet.
